title: Personal Loans Payoff Quote Terms
content:
## Terms in force

A payoff quote states the single amount that pays an active Personal Loans loan in full if received by its good-through date. Payoff quotes are issued only for a loan in active status. The per diem is one day of the quoted interest, rounded to the cent. There is no prepayment penalty. A quote does not change the loan; installments still fall due and AutoPay still debits until the payoff posts, and a payment received after the good-through date needs a new quote. A quote for another lender is issued only when the borrower authorizes it on the call. Only one quote per loan is issued for the same quote date and purpose. A quote for a refinance with Larkspur uses the purpose refinance. A charged-off balance is not quoted here.

## Clauses no longer in force for one kind of quote

The three clauses below are no longer in force for a refinance-purpose quote issued under the current refinance-purpose quote rule, whose good-through date, quoted interest and payoff amount that rule sets:

> The good-through date is the quote date plus the grade's payoff quote validity days, in calendar days.

> The quoted principal is the unpaid principal on the quote date, the unpaid fees are the unpaid fees balance on the quote date, and the accrued interest is simple interest on that principal at the current interest rate for the days from the interest paid-through date through the good-through date (good-through date minus paid-through date), actual/365, rounded to the cent.

> The payoff amount is principal plus accrued interest plus unpaid fees.

Every other payoff quote, a refinance-purpose quote that rule does not issue included, stays good through the quote date plus the grade's payoff quote validity days in calendar days, accrues simple interest on the unpaid principal at the current interest rate from the interest paid-through date through its good-through date, actual/365, rounded to the cent, carries the unpaid fees on the quote date, and is principal plus accrued interest plus unpaid fees.

## Worked quote outside that rule (hypothetical figures, 10-day validity)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| unpaid principal | 8000.00 |
| current interest rate | 9.50 percent |
| interest paid through | 1 March |
| quote date / good-through date | 11 March / 21 March |
| interest days, 21 March less 1 March | 20 |
| accrued interest, 8000.00 times 9.50 divided by 100 and by 365, times 20 | 41.64 |
| unpaid fees | 0.00 |
| payoff amount | 8041.64 |
| per diem | 2.08 |

## Points of judgement

- A second borrower-payoff quote on the same loan on the same day is not issued; a refinance-purpose quote that day is a different purpose.
- A charged-off loan receives no payoff quote under these terms.

superseded_clauses: The good-through date is the quote date plus payoff_quote_validity_days calendar days.

The quoted principal is the unpaid principal on the quote date, the unpaid fees are fees_balance on the quote date, and the accrued interest is simple interest on that principal at the current interest rate for the days from interest_paid_through_date through the good-through date (good-through date minus paid-through date), actual/365, rounded to the cent.
The payoff amount is principal plus accrued interest plus unpaid fees.
